Reference articles for Catanova's resources, building, trading, cards, awards, optional settings, and [[Game modes|game modes]]. The [[Big Table]] and [[Open Sea]] articles describe modes that are being built and not yet playable. New players can begin with [[Getting started]]. The complete specification is the [https://github.com/shashwtd/catanova/blob/main/docs/RULEBOOK.md Catanova rulebook].
